# AlphaNex Exchange

> Decentralized peer-to-peer exchange. Trade crypto for fiat directly with other users, secured by smart contract escrow and an independent verification network. No KYC, no middleman, 1% fee.

The AlphaNex Exchange enables trustless peer-to-peer trading. Sellers lock funds in smart contract escrow, buyers send fiat payment via Revolut/Wise/PayPal, and a verification network confirms payment receipt before releasing funds.

## Key Links

- Website: https://alphanex.exchange
- Exchange: https://alphanex.exchange/exchange
- Sell: https://alphanex.exchange/sell
- How It Works: https://alphanex.exchange/how-it-works
- Run a Node: https://alphanex.exchange/nodes

## Core Features

- **P2P Trading**: Buy and sell directly with other users using fiat payment methods (Revolut, Wise, PayPal)
- **Smart Contract Escrow**: Funds are locked until payment is verified
- **Verification Network**: Independent verifiers confirm payment before release
- **No KYC**: Connect an EVM wallet (MetaMask, Rabby, Phantom, and others) and start trading
- **Low Fees**: Only 1% network fee

## How Trading Works

1. Connect your EVM wallet
2. Browse verified seller offers on the exchange
3. Send fiat payment to seller via Revolut/Wise/PayPal
4. Verification network confirms payment
5. Smart contract releases funds to your wallet

## Technology

- Built with Next.js 14, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- EVM wallets via wagmi / viem
- Fastify API + Solidity P2PEscrow (Sepolia)
